claims.statement: If no intervention-specific first-stage sign for R or F is independently warranted, unrestricted cross-effects make the B_relation+ and B_fit+ prediction sets both equal to {-1,0,+1}^2, so intervention labels alone do not identify the bridge.
claims.domain: Two-arm qualitative total-effect sign model with scoped pure positively oriented bridge candidates.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Does not cover independently bounded first stages, quantitative magnitudes, mixed bridges or actual human feasibility.

claims.statement: With sign(tau_R(Z_R))=-1 and sign(tau_F(Z_F))=-1 established before inspecting J, while both cross-effects remain unrestricted, strict B_relation+ predicts {(-,-),(-,0),(-,+)} and strict B_fit+ predicts {(-,-),(0,-),(+,-)}.
claims.domain: Same fixed two-intervention contract and strict signed sensitivity.
all_premises: targeted first stages nonzero and negative
positive orientation of the relevant input-to-J sign
claims.proof: Substitution into the general prediction-set products; exact enumeration.
claims.counterexamples_limits: The shared (-,-) signature is inconclusive; weak sensitivity enlarges overlap; endpoint orientation is not currently calibrated.

claims.statement: For independently warranted sign sets S_R and S_F, an observed signature distinguishes the scoped candidates exactly when it belongs to one candidate product set and not the other; global separation requires disjoint product sets.
claims.domain: Finite sign-set predictions for the declared intervention family.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Elementary set logic, not a novel general causal-identification theorem.

claims.statement: An off-target intervention effect is part of the prospective total-effect signature, not automatically a confound to regress away; post-formation adjustment cannot be used to create the bridge contrast.
claims.domain: A4A/A4I formation and perturbation design family.
all_premises: post-treatment variables may be mediators/common effects
primary estimand is randomized total effect
claims.proof: Inherited A4A causal-role analysis plus the A4J prediction table.
claims.counterexamples_limits: A separately identified mediation analysis may be valid under additional restrictions; none is installed here.

claims.statement: The sign table does not calibrate H_cont, establish actual retained-relation use, or alter C1/U1; a neither signature rejects only the scoped pure candidates.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Actual complete organization and independently warranted phenomenal interpretation remain open.
